statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The Nasdaq-100 has now held the same contained two-sided band for a further hour with both session extremes rejected and retracements intact, while Stress stays elevated on the after-close Nvidia catalyst.
recommendation: Tail at 12 is well below the block threshold, so the deterministic mapping yields EA_ON. A narrow evidence-based danger window is published for 20:00-23:00 UTC, covering the Nvidia results at approximately 20:20 UTC and the 21:00 UTC conference call.
headline: Nasdaq-100 band holds a fifth hour into Nvidia's after-close report; Tail eases to 12, Stress elevated
body: At the assessment cutoff the Nasdaq-100 cash index trades near 29,146, down about 0.22%, still inside the 29,096.84-29,264.87 session range set against a 29,209.23 previous close and a 29,130.77 open. Price sits just below the midpoint of that band, roughly 50 points above a session low made earlier and rejected, and roughly 120 points below a session high that was also rejected. The range has now contained trade for several consecutive hours at a width of about 0.58%, so mean reversion is demonstrably functioning and no persistent one-way structure is observed. VIX at 15.58 is up 0.13 points on the day inside a narrow 15.41-15.74 range. The 2-year yield near 4.226% and the 10-year near 4.669% are up about 2 and 3 basis points respectively after the hot headline PCE print, which is an orderly repricing rather than a yield-led equity impulse. Crude has pared its earlier decline and trades modestly higher near 83 dollars for WTI, following the Iran-Oman temporary joint maritime corridor and mine-clearing plan for the Strait of Hormuz that removes rather than adds a geopolitical amplifier. July PCE printed slightly hot on the headline at 0.2% month-over-month and 3.7% year-over-year while core matched consensus at 0.2% and 3.3%; durable goods orders beat at 1.1% and the second estimate of Q2 GDP was in line at 1.5%. Meta agreed to a settlement of up to 16.68 billion dollars with 29 states over social-media harms to children, resolving a large single-name legal overhang without creating index-level directional pressure. The dominant scheduled catalyst remains Nvidia's fiscal Q2 2027 report, verified for approximately 20:20 UTC with the conference call at 21:00 UTC, against consensus near 92 billion dollars of revenue and 2.09 dollars of adjusted earnings per share. Delayed latest-session cross-asset context shows megacaps split three higher against five lower and three of seven large semiconductors higher, which is mixed rather than aligned, and index futures are marginally lower; that context is supporting evidence only and is not treated as live price-path structure. Consistent with the published risk definitions, event importance and forecast dispersion are scored into Stress and Confidence rather than into Tail until an actual price path is observed.

lookbackSummary: Over the past 24 hours Claude's published Tail stayed inside a 9-16 band and never reached a blocking level. Risk drifted lower through the 25 August US afternoon and overnight to a trough of 9, then held at 11 through the European morning while Stress climbed steadily from 45 to 57 as the July PCE release and the after-close Nvidia catalyst approached. The 12:00 UTC slot carried the release window at Tail 16 with an event/whipsaw mode; the 13:00 to 15:00 UTC slots then stepped Tail back down to 15, 14 and 13 as the post-release path proved orderly and the session range held.
outlookSummary: The published path holds Tail at 12-13 through the remaining quiet US afternoon, lifts it to a 20-24 band across the 20:00-23:00 UTC window that covers Nvidia's after-close results and conference call, then normalizes it back toward 12-13 through the Asian and European overnight hours. The maximum forecast Tail of 24 keeps the deterministic mapping at WATCH and never reaches the block threshold, because pre-event dispersion is scored as Stress rather than as an already-observed price path. A step up to 15-17 is published for the 27 August 12:30 UTC jobless-claims block and the following 13:30 UTC US cash open, which delivers the first full regular-session verdict on Nvidia.
